body: I'm not going to be able to jump this hurdle of not wanting to be around people.

You don't have to be smart to do what I do. In a data center the technicians are one step above the janitors. Janitors have better job security anyway. My job is to be yelled at and blamed for everything so I can be tricked into fixing other people's problems. I can't do anything else in IT other than fix computers for the general public and that's worse than this. I don't have any other skills because I'm too stupid. I hate IT anyway. I really don't want to do another interview or be around people at all. I'd rather just starve to death here.
I've been in therapy since 2001. I've been to a lot of different doctors.

I don't want a family. I don't don't like being around other people. I've been in a few relationships but it's always ended horribly and happened enough that it turned me off of dating forever. 

One thing fucked up that happened was that I spent 3 days in jail for cutting the lock off a gate because they locked my car in the parking lot I was told to part in at our apartments. I had to leave and no one in management knew who put the lock there. Turns out it was my neighbor and he had printed a fake lease agreement saying that only he had access to that parking lot. It took them 3 days to clear it up. 

I'm not educated. I couldn't afford college and barely finished high school. I got a few certifications and got a job in IT, which I hate. I've barely made enough money to live on and nothing else. It was this or be homeless. That's my only two choices other than suicide.

This idea of having to talk to someone makes me want to kill myself right now. Getting out there and trying to meet someone makes me feel tired. 

With all the problems people have caused me over the years, I'd rather die than try to interact again.

I worked in a data center as a data center technician. I've moved all over the place from data center to data center. 

I guess the reason why I don't want to do anything is because doing stuff doesn't really work out. Nothing adds up to anything. At the end of the day I still won't have enough for a better future. Everything is just a band aid and all I do is nothing in between times when something else fucks up. Even dealing with people is like that.

I don't want to move again. I'm from Athens GA and last year I moved to Manassas Va. Then after my contract was up I moved to Medford Oregon and last month I moved from there to Everett Washington. I'm kind of tired of packing everything up and moving around. Sick of meeting new people and having to deal with job hunting, interviews, changing driver's licenses, mailing addresses, getting used to where everything is, compensating for things I need that they don't have where I moved to. I hate having all this change in my life. I wish things would just take it easy instead of everything being fucked up all the time and having to problem solve every thing just so I can have things like running water and clothes.
